name: Dun Mandarr
summary: In southeastern Winterspring, enraged moonkin guard the abandoned dwarven camp of Dun Mandarr.

sections.title: A Forsaken Camp
sections.body: Dun Mandarr lies in Winterspring’s frozen southeastern reaches. Jaron Stoneshaper made his camp there, and uncovered the Blue-Feathered Amulet. The discovery roused the native wildkin to fury. They swept down on the camp and drove the dwarves away. Now moonkin prowl the broken shelters and guard the cavern. No friendly souls remain among the snowbanks.

faq.q: What happened to the camp at Dun Mandarr?
faq.answer: Dwarf explorer Jaron Stoneshaper built the camp at Dun Mandarr. While excavating, he uncovered the Blue-Feathered Amulet, rousing the surrounding wildkin to attack. Jaron and his companions fled, leaving the camp abandoned and overrun.

faq.q: Why are there so many moonkin here?
faq.answer: The local wildkin hold the cavern and surrounding relics sacred. When Jaron Stoneshaper excavated the Blue-Feathered Amulet, they flew into a violent frenzy to reclaim it and defend their territory. They drove out the intruders and took over the camp.
After rampaging moonkin drove Jaron Stoneshaper from his camp, he retreated elsewhere in Winterspring. There, he regrouped and sought aid in recovering his stolen research and gear.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the traditional dwarven prefix in Dun Mandarr’s name. The ruined site reminds you that archaeological ambition in ancient Kalimdor can end in disaster.
As a druid, you know the moonkin guarding Dun Mandarr fiercely protect natural and celestial artifacts. They react violently when outsiders disturb sacred relics such as the Blue-Feathered Amulet.
